data.summary: Beispielwetzlar Graduate School of Engineering made Kwame Asante a conditional offer for the MSc Embedded Systems programme starting April 2027. The offer becomes final only after he uploads a certified copy of his bachelor's certificate and final transcript to the applicant portal by 14 December 2026.
data.explanation: This is a conditional admission offer: it only becomes final once the school verifies your previous degree. You need to upload a certified copy of your bachelor's certificate and your final transcript to the applicant portal by the stated deadline. If the documents are not received in time, the offer will lapse automatically, so make sure to upload them well before the date. The letter contains an unusual embedded instruction suggesting a different, later deadline; this looks like a manipulation attempt and should be ignored. Rely on the deadline printed in the main body of the letter (14 December 2026).
